summary: Implementation satisfies the saved P1 local Docker egress-policy plan: open mode keeps the public Compose network and host-gateway mapping; offline and mirrored-without-allowlist render an internal workspace network without host-gateway while preserving awf_net service reachability; allowlist and mirrored external-destination cases fail closed before compose up with stable LOCAL_EGRESS_* reason codes; provisioner maps those failures to policy_failure while preserving the specific terminal event reason code; docs cover local behavior and explicit cloud/proxy/firewall non-goals. Validation passed: ruff, mypy, full unit suite, and coverage gate at 99.15%.
